name: Filament shelf
description: The household's filament spools on one shelf: everyone adds what they have, and each model's page shows which filaments it needs and who has them.
author: Thingport contributors

screenshots.caption: Opened on a model: the household's spools, whose each is and how much is left, and the model's three filaments, two already on the shelf and one still to get.
In the dark theme, filtered to one material: every PLA spool in the house, with its brand, line and how much is left on it.
Your own spools are yours to edit, mark used up or take off the shelf; everyone else's are theirs.
Adding what the model needs, in the dark theme: the form starts from the missing filament's material and colour.
